Its prescribed 4-parameter form is not the bridge-mapped node C law; the existing diverse gradient and input rows support fitting the simpler 3-parameter siphon.
The archive specifically maps the epidemic-mobility bridge to node C; no observed evidence requires the extra barrier parameter.
